name: letssign
description: LetsSign — plataforma de assinatura eletrônica avançada com verificação biométrica, criptografia Ed25519 e trilha de auditoria encadeada por hash.
author: Maykon Tardoche

scripts.setup: npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate -w apps/api && npm run db:seed -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.verificar: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
